title: NextDC vows to keep future datacentres away from homes after community backlash in Melbourne
description:
Community expectations around datacentres have changed in the age of AI, chief executive Craig Scroggie says

Community backlash to a datacentre expansion in inner Melbourne that resulted in NextDC’s share price dropping 40% will change the way the company engages with communities – and it says it will no longer pursue new developments near homes.

The company held its first annual general meeting since it was forced to delay the controversial expansion of its M3 site in West Footscray after power provider Jemena paused construction of new 22m power poles amid community protest.
